title: Bar Salts Pineapple Ice Flavour Concentrate 30ml By Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts Pineapple Ice flavour concentrate blends the tropical sweetness of pineapple with a refreshing icy finish. This 30ml concentrate offers a taste of summer with every vape, ideal for those looking to mix a custom e-liquid with a cool, fruity twist. Perfect for DIY enthusiasts, this concentrate allows for a tailored vaping experience. Add your preferred nicotine shots and a VG/PG base to achieve the desired strength and texture, creating a unique and personal vape juice. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
